name: Shocksaw Trap (CR 4)
body:
Shocksaw Trap
CR 4

XP 1,200

Type magic; Perception DC 20; Disable Device DC 20

EFFECTS

Trigger sight (true seeing); Reset automatic

Effect whirling electrified circular saw blade on an articulated metal arm reaches out of a slot in a wall to strike at a target within a 15-foot reach (+10 melee, 2d6+3/19–20 damage plus 3d6 electricity damage)
